source.dataset: Scanned hospital chart, restructured for simulation
source.data_fidelity: Medical values are copied from the source chart. null means the value was not provided.
adaptation_notes: Original chart was an inpatient admission; converted to an outpatient clinic visit. Admission/discharge details, NG tube, and hospital course moved to ground_truth.
Respiratory_Rate: chart had 40 (physical exam sheet) and 55 (day-1 vitals chart). 40 was used.
Sodium: lab form had 139, flow sheet had 134. 139 was used. Chemistry taken from the later lab form (has the full set).
Patient name is fictional. National ID, address, hospital name and admission number were removed.
history.Fever is null: fever appears only in the inpatient notes, not in the pre-visit history. Author may fill it.
X-ray result is not in the source, so it is null.
ground_truth.Diagnosis_Presumptive is a DRAFT: the chart never states a diagnosis.

opening.patient_line: Doctor, my baby keeps vomiting forcefully, and now she has diarrhea too.

information_policy.missing_value_policy: Never invent missing information. If a value is null, report it as not documented.

patient_actor_rules: The baby cannot speak; the mother answers on her behalf, in first person as the mother.
Use only information contained in patient and history.
Do not invent symptoms, duration, vital signs, or history.
Do not reveal laboratory results or imaging findings before they are requested.
Do not reveal diagnosis, severity, management, or outcome.
If asked about information not present in the source, say the mother does not know.

history.Previous_Medications: Danstasol syrup (8 small spoons), Iswid Daman syrup (8 small spoons), and ORS solution

field_descriptions.simulation.opening.patient_line: the mother's chief complaint: what is wrong with the baby, why they came, what the baby suffers from, the main problem
field_descriptions.patient.Name: the baby's name
field_descriptions.patient.Social_Status: who the baby lives with, home and family situation
field_descriptions.history.Vomiting: whether the baby vomits (throwing up), and the type of vomiting, e.g. projectile or forceful
field_descriptions.history.Diarrhea: whether the baby has diarrhea or loose stools
field_descriptions.history.Fever: whether the baby had a fever at home before the visit
field_descriptions.history.Systems_Review: any other complaints or symptoms in other body systems (cough, breathing, urine, etc.)
field_descriptions.history.Previous_Medications: medicines or treatments the baby already received or the mother already gave before this visit
field_descriptions.history.Adverse_Drug_Reaction: any previous bad reaction to a medicine
field_descriptions.physical_exam.Body_Temperature: body temperature in degrees Celsius; fever
field_descriptions.physical_exam.Respiratory_Rate: respiratory rate, breathing rate per minute
field_descriptions.physical_exam.General_Appearance: general appearance of the baby on examination
field_descriptions.physical_exam.Skin_Rash: whether a skin rash is present on examination
field_descriptions.laboratory_investigations.WBC_Count: white blood cell count (WBC) in the CBC
field_descriptions.laboratory_investigations.RBC_Count: red blood cell count (RBC) in the CBC
field_descriptions.imaging.xray.findings.Body_Part: which body part the X-ray covered
field_descriptions.imaging.xray.findings.Result: the X-ray result or findings, what the X-ray showed

ground_truth.review_status: DRAFT - the source chart does not state a diagnosis. Must be confirmed by the case author or a clinician.
ground_truth.Secondary_Findings: microcytic anemia (low hemoglobin, low MCV); low potassium; skin rash with dermatology differential of milia rubra
ground_truth.Management_in_source_chart: Hospitalized about 3 days: cefotaxime, zinc, Nutriboost, NG tube feeding support. Rash treated with Dermo Calm lotion, Fucidin cream, Levohistam oral drops.
ground_truth.Outcome_in_source_chart: Improved; fever resolved and respiratory rate trended down; discharged home.
